clusters.name: Walter's move across the country, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move of the family from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, her distance from Walter as he worked the orchard from dark to dark, Glen's fights at the new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, Walter and June's rows over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir with her anxiety easing by September 1953. The shifts show a family unsettled by the move, with Walter distant and driven, June anxious and then withdrawing to her bed, and Glen acting out at school.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failure, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost and the bank's call destroyed the crop, within the year: Walter's heavy drinking, his conflict with Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian's overfunctioning as they took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, and Nora's bedwetting at eight years old in April 1969 while her mother kept it from her father. Walter's drinking eased and he took work pruning other men's trees by October 1969. The shifts move through the family as the crisis passes, with the children showing symptoms and Glen stepping into his father's role.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen sat in the truck in the yard for hours out of work, he and Marian fought loudly over money at night, Marian took a second job cleaning offices, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, she kept to her room and distanced from her mother, and her father spent most nights at his girlfriend Gail's house. By June 1976, Nora was eating again and made the track team. The period names the trouble Nora told you about, with shifts in functioning and relationship moving from Glen through Marian to Nora, each one's trouble showing in the months after Glen's loss.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into your house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into your house in January 1990 after selling her farm, within the year: you clashed with her over the children's bedtimes and meals, you distanced from Hollis as he worked late and kept out of the rows, he took his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice, Wilma took over Lily's care, you broke out in eczema on both hands, you and Hollis had rows most nights, and your mother drove over twice a week to take your side. By June 1991, Wilma took a flat in town and your eczema cleared over the summer. The shifts show a household divided, with Hollis aligned with his mother against you, the children caught in the middle, and your own symptoms rising and falling with the tension.
